interpretation: Accepted: missing parent-log file, wrong task identity with correct seed, wrong same-episode invocation that exists elsewhere in the manifest, and missing individual durable record now reject.

Positive historical recovery now passes when declared in a stage-correct ledger and manifest; action comparison no longer incorrectly joins across invocations/attempts. The previous unledgered recovery case is now correctly rejected under the explicit ledger requirement, not counted as a remaining false positive.

Still accepted: empty parent log, manifest with no invocation identifiers, parent transcript-hash mismatch and wrong source hash. Parent membership still depends on a nonempty parent set; invocation membership still depends on a nonempty invocation set.

Both ledger negatives pass: wrong declared row counts/totals and an extra historical t=99 row under an otherwise declared episode/invocation/attempt, even with accurate updated counts and horizon=3. _ledger_keys validates only the three-key exemption and ledger stage, not individual historical decision stages, durable_decision_rows or totals. The actual committed ledger nevertheless independently reconciles all five historical rows across four IDs exactly.

The ledger is a new provenance declaration, not recovered lost outcomes. Pre-invocation rows show assignments were recorded; they alone do not prove each model call completed or reconstruct the 665 operator-reported lost results.
The 30 focused fixtures and bounded negative cases do not establish atomic publication or actual-host writer exclusion. No local PID observation is interpreted as remote liveness.
